title: Stop Cutting Corners Too Fast

script.visual_search: driver turning steering wheel tightly close up

script.narration: Turning your steering wheel too early causes your rear tires to climb right over the curb. Instead, wait to turn until your shoulder passes the edge of the curb. This gives your car a wider turning radius and keeps your wheels safe from damage every single time.
script.visual_search: car tire hitting curb street view

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Have you ever hit a curb turning? Comment yes or no.
script.visual_search: hands on steering wheel driving POV

script.narration: So remember to stop cutting corners too sharply.

description: Learn the correct way to handle tight turns without hitting curbs. Master this simple driving tip for new drivers and improve your confidence behind the wheel immediately.
why_it_will_work: Leverages real search queries for new driver tips and practical vehicle handling, directly addressing a common physical mistake drivers make.
